deployments_detail.use: BMO Institute for Applied AI & Quantum consolidating decades-long use of AI across client experience, productivity and efficiency

Rovr AI: AI-powered digital assistant for BMO Insurance life-insurance advisors, giving real-time access to applicant data, medical history, product info and underwriting materials to streamline field underwriting risk assessment. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]

SmartDecision: AI-enhanced life-insurance underwriting platform delivering real-time coverage decisions at point of sale, automating the application process and eliminating traditional medical requirements for eligible applicants. [BMO Insurance (advanced analytics, predictive modelling, AI); integrates with Rovr AI and SmartApp]
deployments_detail.value: Instant decisions on coverage up to $5 million across Term/Universal/Whole Life; cycle time cut from weeks to seconds

deployments_detail.use: Riskfuel derivative pricing: neural-network models replace CPU-based Monte Carlo simulations for pricing structured notes and derivatives, delivering near-instant risk valuation for BMO Capital Markets clients. [Riskfuel Analytics; NVIDIA DGX A100 GPUs; PyTorch/TensorFlow]
deployments_detail.value: Trained on 650 million data points; pricing that previously took minutes reduced dramatically (no exact figure)

deployments_detail.use: CashTrack Insight: machine-learning tool in the BMO Mobile Banking app that predicts upcoming cash shortfalls up to seven days in advance and recommends corrective actions to retail customers. [BMO in-house (with Personetics personalization)]

Pricing and risk-management AI agent gathering data from pricing models for BMO's capital markets team, with human employees authorizing actions and the agent learning from feedback. [BMO (not disclosed)]

Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat rolled out to employees for internal productivity (drafting, summarization, research) to free up time for strategic work; also piloted in BMO Insurance for marketing/training/operational content. [Microsoft (Microsoft 365 Copilot)]

Compliance automation and customer call-transcript analysis AI agents automating internal compliance processes and analyzing customer calls to identify pain points and improve communication. [BMO (not disclosed)]

Operational Loss Intelligence (OLI): machine-learning solution ingesting internal and external data to predict the probability of operational losses from human errors in trading, providing early-warning signals. [BMO in-house]
deployments_detail.value: Predicted 62% probability of a trading event in European equities before a fat-finger error occurred; error rates flat-to-down as volume grew

deployments_detail.use: Fraud detection: hundreds of machine-learning algorithms running to detect scams and fraudulent transactions, plus chatbots/virtual assistants to triage customer fraud reports, with human analysts in the loop. [BMO in-house (vendors not named)]

SegMate: computer-vision toolkit applying AI to satellite imagery to track deforestation, land use, water bodies and disaster response for climate-risk assessment. [Vector Institute in collaboration with BMO and Telus (open source)]

Lumi Assistant: generative-AI assistant giving frontline banking staff instant access to 8,000+ personal and business banking policies, procedures, job aids and SOPs in English and French, summarizing documents and surfacing actionable guidance. [BMO in-house (generative AI); developed with Vector Institute collaboration]
deployments_detail.value: 8,000+ policies/procedures accessible; won 'Best Use of Gen AI for Customer Experience - Canada' 2025 Digital Banker CX Awards

deployments_detail.use: BMO Savings Amplifier: AI-powered savings solution in the mobile banking app that lets customers set personalized savings goals, automate transfers and receive personalized nudges to encourage saving. [Personetics]
deployments_detail.value: Tens of thousands of customers; 100,000+ savings goals set; 4.7/5 satisfaction; Celent Model Bank Award
